name: Charlga Razorflank
summary: In Razorfen Kraul, Charlga Razorflank leads the Razorfen quilboar. They drove the tauren from the southern Barrens, claiming to fight in the name of their fallen god, Agamaggan.

sections.title: The Crone of the Kraul
sections.body: Charlga Razorflank rules from the tangled brambles of Razorfen Kraul. Her people revere her as a master geomancer, and no quilboar can match her experimental magic. She united her fractious kin into a lethal force. With primal earth and giant thorns growing from the remains of the demigod Agamaggan, Charlga reshaped the Kraul into a fortress that is hard to enter.

sections.title: Expansion and Betrayal
sections.body: Charlga Razorflank sent her warriors against rival tribes and Horde villages across the southern Barrens. Their attacks drove the tauren from their traditional homelands. Charlga also made secret bargains with emissaries of the undead Scourge, trading her unsuspecting tribe's devotion for unnatural power and dark alliances.

aliases: who is the crone of the kraul
faq.answer: Charlga Razorflank leads the Razorfen quilboar and rules from her lair deep within Razorfen Kraul in the southern Barrens.
Charlga Razorflank is a gifted geomancer who commands elemental earth and the great blood-brambles born from the demigod Agamaggan.

faq.q: Why did the quilboar attack the tauren in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Charlga Razorflank led the Razorfen quilboar against rival tribes and Horde villages, driving the tauren from the southern Barrens.

faq.q: What is Charlga's connection to Razorfen Downs?
faq.answer: Razorfen Downs grew from the same mighty vines as Charlga's Kraul. It is the quilboar's traditional capital and home to the Death's Head tribe and its high priests. Charlga rules Razorfen Kraul, not the Downs.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want her dead?
faq.answer: The tauren and their Horde allies see Charlga as an immediate threat because of her relentless raids, her seizure of their lands, and her dangerous dealings with dark forces.

angles.text: Charlga's expansion drove your people from their ancestral lands across the southern Barrens. Defeating her means survival and reclaiming those lands.
Charlga commands powerful geomantic arts, but her twisting of the elements corrupts sacred primal traditions.
Defeating Charlga helps secure caravan routes and encampments across the southern Barrens from relentless quilboar war parties.
